title: Midnight Accent * Sleeps 4 * Walk to Broadway
description:
Welcome to your Music City retreat — a cool, funky, and elevated one-bedroom designed for comfort, style, and unbeatable Nashville access. Perfect for friends, couples, and business travelers, this thoughtfully laid-out space features two queen beds and comfortably sleeps up to four. Enjoy resort-style amenities including a pool, gym, and sky lounge. Whether you’re walking to Broadway for the best music, dining or nightlife, enjoy a seamless blend of sophistication and fun. Parking available.

The space
Our space provides two queen size beds which easily accommodates 4 guests.

There is 50 inch smart tv where you can stream your favorite apps.

Kitchen is stocked with essentials ready for use.

There is a washer and dryer in the unit. 

Dining table for 4.

**Located in a lively downtown area! Light sleepers may experience nighttime noise from nearby nightlife and street activity, especially on weekends.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire unit and all of the building's amenities.

Please note, to access the pool, you must have all of your guests names added in your Airbnb reservation.

Please note, we are not responsible for any amenities closure during your stay if they are having maintenance or repairs.
